description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'FormatWithCompetencyTest' for testing the 'FormatWithCompetency' class within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, initializes the class, and verifies the 'getFormattedValue' method's output with different input values.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetencyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for 'FormatWithCompetency', testing the formatting of competency levels.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads test data from fixtures, and creates an instance of 'FormatWithCompetency'.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that 'getFormattedValue' returns correct string labels for input ids 1 through 4.
